subject.title: Gateway Dashboard chat buttons lose busy state after tab switch and can interrupt active runs

question: Should maintainers adopt or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067, ask the contributor to rebase and prove it, or close it after another current-main fix owns this Dashboard recovery issue?
rationale: The issue has a linked open PR with closing syntax, but that PR is conflicting and proof-gated while current main already contains partial recovery behavior, so automation should not queue a new fix without a maintainer choosing the fix path.

options.title: Adopt or replace on current main
options.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current active-run/session lifecycle helpers and live Dashboard proof.

options.title: Ask contributor to rebase and prove
options.body: The original contributor can update the existing PR against current main and add redacted live tab-switch/reconnect evidence before another review.

options.title: Close after replacement lands
options.body: If another PR becomes the viable fix path, close the stale linked PR and then close this issue when the replacement is merged and proven.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace on current main
recommendation.body: A maintainer-owned rewrite or replacement can preserve the useful recovery intent while using current active-run/session lifecycle helpers and live Dashboard proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent history on the Gateway session method surface and is the best available owner for choosing the current-main repair path.
